about: This pack stores no data. There is no database. The page is rendered from one typed content file written from the brief at build time.

holds: contact: address, phone, email, hours (one line per day or range, as written)
links: reserve, order, catering, menu, delivery (only addresses the owner's own site or the owner gave)
menu: show_prices switch, categories with items (name, optional description, optional price as written), pinned highlights
pictures (gallery, hero, about) and the usePhotos switch
catering heading, text and up to four cards
testimonials (quote, author, source, rating only if stated)

rules: Page content lives only in the content file. It is not edited in a screen; changes are made by asking the builder.
Text read from the owner's site is copied word for word, including its spelling. The builder does not correct, shorten, translate or reword it.
A price is stored as the owner's site wrote it (for example $6.95) and shown as written. A missing price stays missing. show_prices false hides every price on the page and nothing else.

A picture is used only when usePhotos is true. usePhotos is true only when the brief records that the owner confirmed they own the site and its pictures (images.owner_confirmed), or when the brief is a private test (private_test true). A private test is never published, because the runner refuses to deploy it, so showing the pictures there only lets the builder see the real page.
A picture belongs to a dish only when its alt text equals the dish name exactly.
A section with nothing real to show is not drawn and not in the navigation. visibleSections() in src/lib/content.ts decides this and is not reimplemented.
Stars are drawn only for a rating the owner's site showed next to the quote.
A button or link exists only when it has a real https, tel or mailto address.
